#!/bin/bash

set -e  # Exit immediately if a command exits with a non-zero status

# Install Java 17 (required by Spring Security)
apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk

# Set JAVA_HOME environment variable
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH

# Clone the Spring Security repository (to the current directory)
git clone https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security.git
cd spring-security

# Install the required Python version (3.12.0)
pyenv install -f 3.12.0
pyenv global 3.12.0

# Upgrade pip and install dependencies using poetry (if available) or default methods
pip install --upgrade pip

# Exit if requirements.txt or build.gradle is not found
if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
    pip install -r requirements.txt
elif [ -f setup.py ]; then
    pip install -e .
elif [ -f build.gradle ]; then
    echo "No Python dependencies found in Gradle build file."
else
    echo "No dependency files found."
    exit 1
fi

# Run project tests (default command for testing)

#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Specifying the required Python version
PYTHON_VERSION="3.9.18"

# Install the specific Python version using pyenv
pyenv install -f $PYTHON_VERSION
pyenv global $PYTHON_VERSION

# Check if pip is installed and setup required libraries
pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip

# Install required system packages
apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    clang-format \
    clang-tidy \
    doxygen \
    graphviz

# Assuming the current directory has setup.py or requirements.txt
if [ -f "setup.py" ]; then
    pip install -e .
elif [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
    pip install -r requirements.txt
else
    echo "No setup.py or requirements.txt found, cannot install dependencies."
    exit 1
fi

# Run the project's automated tests using pytest
pytest

#!/bin/bash

set -e

# Define the Python version required by the project
PYTHON_VERSION="3.10.13"

# Install the required Python version using pyenv (force installation)
pyenv install -f $PYTHON_VERSION
pyenv global $PYTHON_VERSION

# Upgrade pip to the latest version
pip install --upgrade pip

# Install dependencies for the project (editable mode)
for library in langchain langchain-text-splitters langchain-core langchain-model-profiles langchain-v1 langchain-tests; do
    cd libs/$library
    pip install -e .
    cd -
done

# Run the project's automated tests using pytest
cd libs/standard-tests
pytest -vv

elif [ -f setup.py ]; then
    pip install -e .
elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
    poetry install --no-interaction
fi
